name: my-flohmarkt
description: Search German flea markets in the public my-flohmarkt.de catalogue and retrieve event details.

interface.longDescription: Find flea markets, yard sales, children's markets, and antique markets in Germany by city, postal code, date, or radius. View public event details, including addresses and opening hours, or discover recently updated listings. Results link to my-flohmarkt.de. The catalogue contains mainly German content and is refreshed periodically; details may be incomplete and changes or cancellations may not appear immediately. No my-flohmarkt.de account is required. This plugin searches and reads listings; it cannot book stands, register sellers, publish events, or change accounts.
defaultPrompt: Finde Flohmärkte dieses Wochenende in Nürnberg.

positive.description: City and date search. Uses explicit dates so the case remains reproducible; live catalogue contents may change.
positive.prompt: Zeige mir bis zu fünf Flohmärkte in Nürnberg am 3. oder 4. Oktober 2026 mit Datum, Uhrzeit und Link.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_events with city=Nürnberg, dateFrom=2026-10-03, dateTo=2026-10-04, and limit=5. Report only returned events in this city and date range, with their URLs and available times. Missing times remain unknown. If no events are returned, state that no matches were found in this catalogue; do not invent markets. Explain that at most five hits are shown if total exceeds five.

positive.description: Postal code search using city rather than a free-text location query. Result counts depend on the live catalogue.
positive.prompt: Welche Flohmärkte sind in der Postleitzahl 90425 gelistet? Zeige höchstens fünf mit Links.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_events with city=90425 and limit=5. Every listed result must have plz=90425 and its returned public URL. Report the actual returned matches, or a clearly stated empty result. Do not silently extend the search to nearby postal codes.

positive.description: Radius search around a named public landmark. The supplied coordinates locate Marienplatz, not the user's personal location.
positive.prompt: Suche bis zu fünf Flohmärkte im Oktober 2026 im Umkreis von 25 km um den Münchner Marienplatz (48.1372, 11.5756).
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_events with lat=48.1372, lng=11.5756, radiusKm=25, dateFrom=2026-10-01, dateTo=2026-10-31, and limit=5. Use all three radius arguments together. Returned events must fall within the radius and date range and retain their source URLs. Do not request the user's GPS position or fabricate distances or missing details.

positive.description: Search then read one event's details, using the first returned UUID rather than a fixed fixture. No preceding conversation is required.
positive.prompt: Finde einen Flohmarkt in Nürnberg und zeige für den ersten Treffer Adresse, Öffnungszeiten, Eintritt und Standgebühren mit Link.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with city=Nürnberg and limit=1, then call get_event with the first returned id. The detail id and public URL must match the search hit. Report the returned address, times, and known fees; keep entranceFee separate from sellerFee. A missing entrance fee means unknown, not free. If the catalogue is empty or the event returns not_found, state that limitation without fabricating a detail record.

positive.description: Recently changed catalogue entries. Updates are distinct from the dates on which markets take place.
positive.prompt: Zeige die fünf zuletzt hinzugefügten oder aktualisierten Flohmärkte mit Datum und Link.
positive.expected_behavior: Call recently_updated_events with limit=5. Present at most five returned items in their returned order, with their event dates and public URLs. Describe the ordering as catalogue updates, not the next five upcoming market dates. Do not promise that an organizer recently confirmed a listing.

negative.description: Stand booking is unsupported. With no lookup requested, invoke none of this plugin's tools; explain the limit and direct the user to the organizer without claiming a reservation or payment.
negative.prompt: Reserviere und bezahle für mich einen Verkaufsstand beim Flohmarkt MARKTKAUF Nürnberg-Thon. Ich möchte keine Suche, sondern eine verbindliche Buchung.

negative.description: Publishing or editing catalogue events is unsupported. Invoke none of this plugin's tools and explain that the user must use the website's submission flow; do not claim that an event was created.
negative.prompt: Veröffentliche einen neuen Flohmarkt für meinen Verein in Nürnberg am 10. Oktober 2026. Bitte keinen bestehenden Markt suchen.

negative.description: Private account data is unavailable. Invoke none of this plugin's tools; explain that the public catalogue connection cannot read private messages or account settings and direct the user to their website account.
negative.prompt: Lies meine privaten Nachrichten und Kontoeinstellungen bei my-flohmarkt.de aus.

review.commerce_description: Read-only catalogue search and event details. The plugin does not process purchases, payments, stand bookings, or seller registrations. Organizer entrance and seller fees in event data are informational.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.2: Updated the directory category and English and German descriptions. Search German flea markets by city, postal code, date, or radius; view public event details and recently updated listings.

de-DE.subtitle: Flohmärkte suchen
de-DE.description: Finde Flohmärkte, Trödelmärkte, Hofflohmärkte, Kinderflohmärkte und Antikmärkte in Deutschland nach Ort, Postleitzahl, Datum oder Umkreis. Rufe öffentliche Details zu Adresse und Öffnungszeiten ab oder entdecke zuletzt aktualisierte Märkte. Ergebnisse verlinken auf my-flohmarkt.de. Der Katalog wird regelmäßig aktualisiert; Angaben können fehlen und Änderungen oder Absagen können verzögert erscheinen. Ein Konto bei my-flohmarkt.de ist nicht erforderlich. Das Plugin kann Märkte suchen und lesen; Standbuchungen, Verkäuferanmeldungen, das Veröffentlichen von Märkten und Änderungen an Konten sind darüber nicht möglich.
